items.quote: Mr. Bouie knows coustomer service. He's a rare gem in Miami because he is a man of his word. We had several stumps to be removed and he went above and beyond to make everything look great and even hauled it all out. Great communicator, positive vibes, well equipped, honest fair pricing

I needed to remove some trees along with some stump grinding. Mr. Bouie was professional, showed up on time with the correct equipment, completed the work quickly and at a great price. I was impressed and I don't impress easily.

Excellent service to remove and stump grind dead tree as well as general tree trimming. Very well equipped with top notch machines. Tidy up when finished. Reasonable price and arrive for work on schedule. Plus, just super pleasant and friendly folks.

Amazing and prompt service by this company. They dug up a significant number of roots from the hedges that I had previously cut down along my fence line, ground down two stumps, and fully removed two additional trees and a large bush. The price was very reasonable, and the cleaned up the yard nicely at the end. I highly recommend their services.
